source.title: Floor Plan | G+1 | 30×40 Plot
source.description:
This thoughtfully planned G+1 residence on a 30×40 west-facing plot features 3 spacious bedrooms, open living spaces, ample natural light, and functional layouts perfect for modern family living.

From a practical ground floor to a private first floor and an open terrace ready for future possibilities, every detail is designed with comfort in mind.

Would you build a home like this? Let us know in the comments!
#floorplan #homedesigninspo #houseplan #architecture #fyp

pack.topic: G+1 Residential Floor Plan & Space Optimization
pack.source_script_insight: Maximizing utility, light, and ventilation across multiple levels in a compact 30x40 plot without feeling cramped.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Designing space-efficient G+1 homes for standard urban plots in areas like RS Puram or Saibaba Colony in Coimbatore.
pack.core_takeaway: Smart layout planning ensures 3 bedrooms, parking, and multiple balconies fit perfectly in a 30x40 plot.

Scene 1 (0.0-1.4s): Eye-level steady smartphone shot of an empty 30x40 residential plot in Coimbatore under bright daylight, real dust and surrounding concrete walls, overlay text '30x40 Plot Plan'. Scene 2 (1.4-2.8s): Low angle push-in on a newly cast concrete parking slab, realistic rough texture, overlay text 'Ground Floor'. Scene 3 (2.8-4.2s): Medium pan shot of open brick masonry walls inside a building site, natural lighting, overlay text 'Open Layout'. Scene 4 (4.2-5.6s): Gimbal tracking shot showing three distinct bedroom door openings on the first floor, raw brickwork, overlay text '3 Bedrooms'. Scene 5 (5.6-7.0s): Tilt-up steady shot of a cantilevered first-floor concrete balcony slab overlooking a Coimbatore street, overlay text 'Balcony View'. Scene 6 (7.0-8.5s): High angle pan of a staircase headroom on a finished roof slab, realistic cement texture, overlay text 'Roof Terrace'. Scene 7 (8.5-10.0s): Steady eye-level shot of freshly plastered exterior walls of a G+1 house in Coimbatore, realistic daytime lighting, overlay text 'OliveTree Builders'.
